result.instructions: Tools for Memberful, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Memberful data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run memberful_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run memberful_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run memberful_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. memberful_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: get_member
tools.title: Get a member
tools.description: Fetch one Memberful member by id: profile, Stripe customer id, unrestricted-access flag, total spend, metadata, address, and their subscriptions (each with plan). Memberful GraphQL: member(id).

tools.name: list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List members (Relay connection): each edge has a cursor + node (profile, Stripe customer id, unrestricted-access flag, total spend, and their subscriptions). Paginate with `first` + `after` (pass the last edge's `cursor`); `first` defaults to 50. Set `activeOnly` to return only members with an ACTIVE membership state. For member-state filters beyond active, use memberful_query. Memberful GraphQL: members connection.

first.description: Max members to return, from the start (page size).

after.description: Cursor for the next page (the `cursor` of the last edge from a prior call).

last.description: Max members to return, from the end.

activeOnly.description: Only return members with an ACTIVE membership state.

tools.name: get_subscription
tools.title: Get a subscription
tools.description: Fetch one subscription by id: status, activated/expires/trial timestamps, plan, member, orders, coupon. Memberful GraphQL: subscription(id).

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions (Relay connection): each edge has a cursor + node (status, expires/created timestamps, plan, member). Paginate with `first` + `after` (pass the last edge's `cursor`); `first` defaults to 50. NOTE: this uses the top-level `subscriptions` connection, which is sourced from the community SDK — validate against a live account. Memberful GraphQL: subscriptions connection.

first.description: Max subscriptions to return, from the start (page size).

after.description: Cursor for the next page (the `cursor` of the last edge from a prior call).

last.description: Max subscriptions to return, from the end.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.title: List plans
tools.description: List all plans (Memberful dashboard 'Prices'): name, interval, price (cents), for-sale flag, plan group. Memberful GraphQL: plans.

tools.name: list_passes
tools.title: List passes
tools.description: List all passes (Memberful dashboard 'Plans' — the access groups a member subscribes to): id, name. Memberful GraphQL: passes.

tools.name: memberful_query
tools.title: Run a GraphQL query (read-only)
tools.description: Escape hatch: run an arbitrary Memberful GraphQL QUERY (read-only) against your account's /api/graphql endpoint with optional variables. Mutations are REJECTED — use the dedicated write tools or memberful_graphql for those. Useful for fields not covered by the curated read tools (e.g. member-state filters beyond active).

query.description: A GraphQL query document (must be a query, not a mutation).

tools.name: create_member
tools.title: Create a member
tools.description: MUTATES Memberful data: create a new member with an email (and optional full name). Memberful GraphQL: memberCreate(email, fullName).

tools.name: update_member
tools.title: Update a member
tools.description: MUTATES Memberful data: update a member's metadata (a JSON string; max 50 keys, 40-char keys, 500-char values). Only metadata is supported here; for other inline member fields use memberful_graphql. Memberful GraphQL: memberUpdate(id, metadata).

metadata.description: Metadata as a JSON string (max 50 keys, 40-char keys, 500-char values).

tools.name: change_subscription_expiration
tools.title: Change subscription expiration
tools.description: MUTATES Memberful data: change WHEN a subscription expires (extend or shorten access). expiresAt is a Unix timestamp in SECONDS (Int). Memberful GraphQL: subscriptionChangeExpirationTime(id, expiresAt).

expiresAt.description: New expiration as a Unix timestamp in SECONDS (Int, required).

tools.name: create_coupons
tools.title: Create coupons
tools.description: MUTATES Memberful data: create one or more coupon codes for a discount. Provide the discount id (discountId) and the coupon code strings. Memberful GraphQL: createCoupons(discountId, coupons).

codes.description: Coupon code strings to create (at least one, required).

discountId.description: The discount id to attach the coupons to.

tools.name: memberful_graphql
tools.title: Run a GraphQL operation (query or mutation)
tools.description: MUTATES Memberful data (potentially): escape hatch to run an arbitrary Memberful GraphQL operation — including any mutation — against your account's /api/graphql endpoint with optional variables. Prefer memberful_query for read-only calls.

query.description: A GraphQL query or mutation document.

annotations.title: Run a GraphQL operation (query or mutation)
